amid.definition: A Ghaznavid administrative title for a mid-level civil or financial official - used here for the officer overseeing a customs post.

ushr.definition: A customs tithe on goods entering or crossing Muslim territory - roughly 5% for Muslim traders, up to double for non-Muslim or foreign ones - collected at frontier posts like this one.

zuhr.definition: One of the five daily prayers, performed after the sun passes its zenith at midday.

adhan.definition: The Islamic call to prayer, sounded aloud to mark each of the five daily prayer times.
